root_cause: Round-4 multi-second p90 that grew with duration was caused by a len(words)*280 ms segment cap that crushed each line to ~1.4 s. Only the first word locked; the rest were interpolated early. Not an MMS frame-hop / resampling bug — absolute timebase at 30/120/240 s was already fine (~20–40 ms).
fix: Neighbor-clamped LRCLIB line windows (±1.5 s), emission frame_ms from tensor length, 40 ms MMS lag compensate, per-line first-word agreement gate with LRCLIB fallback, monotonic interp inside the line only. Marker [drome-aligned:v4-ctc-line].

round5_synth_full_demucs.note: Full-length TTS over music bed, run through Demucs, scored vs TTS truth. No previews, no CTC self-score.
round5_synth_full_demucs.verdict: All six variants meet median≤60 / p90≤150 / |drift|≤30 on valid Demucs+truth eval. Propose enabling when Charles is ready; leave DROME_LYRICS_ALIGN default false.

quality_gate.per_line: first CTC word within 1s of LRCLIB line start, else keep that line's LRCLIB stamps
quality_gate.per_word: posterior >= min_score else interpolate monotonically inside the line
